conversion_rule: SNK Neo Geo buttons + motions -> Tekken-style inputs. A (LP)=1, C (HP)=2, B (LK)=3, D (HK)=4. f/b/d/u directions map directly. qcf/qcb/dp/hcb/hcf/qcb+hcf/qcf,qcf/qcb,qcb/hcb,hcb motions preserved. Charge motions noted, Tekken input keeps the end direction+button. Close-only throws = 1+3-family. Colliding inputs get a ~variant suffix on the key only; entry.input keeps the true input.
limb_convention: 1=armR(LP), 2=armL(HP), 3=legL(LK), 4=legR(HK); input keys prefixed ~ are dictionary variants sharing an input

b,f+1.name: Baltic Launcher
b,f+1.notes: charge b,f+A/B, EX OK; energy sphere projectile

b,f+3.name: Grand Saber
b,f+3.notes: charge b,f+B/D, EX OK; running slash, has follow-up

d,u+1.name: Moon Slasher
d,u+1.notes: charge d,u+A/C, EX OK; ring of cutting energy

f+4.name: Grand Saber (Follow Up)
f+4.notes: f+D after D Grand Saber; jumping circular slash

qcb+1.name: Earring Bomb
qcb+1.notes: qcb+A/C, EX OK; exploding earring projectile

qcb+1~air.name: X-Calibur
qcb+1~air.notes: air qcb+A/C, EX OK; cross-shaped projectile

qcb,hcf+1+2.name: Leona Blade
qcb,hcf+1+2.notes: Climax; Riot-form energy blade slash into explosion
